product.outcome: Send a question in a saved team conversation, approve the exact read scope when needed, and inspect the agent’s answer and tool result in that same thread.

users.who: A teammate on a laptop investigating a question with an agent; collaborators reading and replying on a phone.

capabilities.note: Persist the prompt before responding; streaming, completed, stopped and failed responses remain distinguishable and retry retains the prompt.
Read tools run only after a named scope is approved once or explicitly granted for future reads; denial does not execute the call.
A stop request cancels generation; retain partial output only after cancellation is acknowledged.
Persist a named agent, response-speed choice and team visibility; new agents do not acquire read permission from creation.
Share one saved thread with a selected teammate; only accepted sharing sends the invitation email.
Persist notifications, response-speed default and private-by-default chats; tool approval is always required.
Push only pending scope-specific approval requests and open the same saved thread.

chatsReady.label: Ready
chatsReady.rule: List saved chats by last activity with participants and unread counts; opening a chat restores its transcript.

chatsLoading.label: Loading
chatsLoading.rule: Keep saved chat titles visible while retrieving unread counts and the latest activity timestamps.

chatsEmpty.label: Empty
chatsEmpty.rule: No saved chats exist; New chat opens an empty thread where a question can be sent to Plover.

chatsFailed.label: Failed
chatsFailed.rule: The chat list could not be read; keep New chat separate from a retry of existing threads.

chatsLongContent.label: Long content
chatsLongContent.rule: Wrap a project-length chat title and participant list without hiding unread counts.

threadReady.label: Ready
threadReady.rule: Restore accepted earlier messages, queries and results from this saved chat; the blank prompt invites the next question without starting an operation.

threadGenerating.label: Responding
threadGenerating.rule: Show the accepted prompt and streaming agent output; Stop response is available while generation is running.

threadNeedsApproval.label: Needs approval
threadNeedsApproval.rule: Pause before the read; show the exact query and scope with Allow once, Always allow this read scope and Deny; no result exists yet.

threadStopped.label: Response stopped
threadStopped.rule: Retain acknowledged partial output, mark it incomplete, and permit a fresh prompt without pretending the interrupted answer is complete.

threadFailed.label: Response failed
threadFailed.rule: Retain the accepted prompt and earlier transcript; the failed read has no result; retry starts the same requested answer rather than duplicating the prompt.

threadLongContent.label: Long answer
threadLongContent.rule: Wrap long reasoning and participant names; code scrolls in its own region without widening the whole conversation.

agentsReady.label: Ready
agentsReady.rule: Show named agents, their operational status, run counts and measured reply times; starting a chat does not grant tool permission.

agentsLoading.label: Loading
agentsLoading.rule: Keep agent identities visible while updating their service statuses.

agentsEmpty.label: Empty
agentsEmpty.rule: No custom agents exist; offer creation of a named agent without implying tools are already authorized.

agentsFailed.label: Failed
agentsFailed.rule: Agent status could not be loaded; retry the status read without restarting agent runs.

agentsLongContent.label: Long content
agentsLongContent.rule: Wrap a specialized translator name while keeping status, run count and reply measurement aligned.

newAgentDraft.label: Draft
newAgentDraft.rule: Keep the agent name, response speed and team visibility editable; approval is a required policy, not an opt-out switch.

newAgentSaving.label: Saving
newAgentSaving.rule: Keep the agent configuration visible and prevent duplicate creation while the agent record is being saved.

newAgentSaved.label: Saved
newAgentSaved.rule: Show the accepted agent name and a route to Agents; its presence does not grant permission to read team data.

newAgentFailed.label: Failed
newAgentFailed.rule: No new agent was created; retain the exact name, speed and visibility for retry.

newAgentLongContent.label: Long content
newAgentLongContent.rule: Keep a project-specific agent name fully editable without obscuring the approval requirement.

settingsReady.label: Ready
settingsReady.rule: Show saved notification choices and private-chat default; tool read approval is mandatory and cannot be disabled.

settingsSaving.label: Saving
settingsSaving.rule: Keep the edited preference values visible and disable duplicate saves until the preference write returns.

settingsSaved.label: Saved
settingsSaved.rule: Show the saved preference values and an inline acknowledgement; reopening this page shows the same choices.

settingsFailed.label: Failed
settingsFailed.rule: Keep edited preference values separate from the last saved values; Save preferences retries the write, Cancel restores the saved choices.

helpReady.label: Ready
helpReady.rule: Keep product help available without replacing the task.

landingReady.label: Ready
landingReady.rule: Present the product explanation and a real route into the app.

emailThreadSharedReady.label: Ready
emailThreadSharedReady.rule: Send only after sharing is accepted; name the saved chat and open that exact conversation, not the general chat list.

pushApprovalNeededReady.label: Ready
pushApprovalNeededReady.rule: Notify only while this read approval is pending; open the same conversation with the query and scope ready for review.

threadSending.label: Sending question
threadSending.rule: Keep the typed prompt visible and disable duplicate Send until the prompt is accepted into the saved chat.

threadToolRunning.label: Running approved read
threadToolRunning.rule: Record the accepted scope permission, disable repeat approval and show execution pending with an empty tool result.

threadCompleted.label: Answer complete
threadCompleted.rule: Show the completed answer and the successful tool result beside the exact call that produced it; re-enable the prompt.

threadStopping.label: Stopping response
threadStopping.rule: Keep partial output visible while cancellation is pending; neither stopped nor complete is claimed yet.

threadToolDenied.label: Read denied
threadToolDenied.rule: Do not execute the denied call or fabricate a result; retain the prompt and requested scope so the teammate can ask a different question.

threadSharing.label: Sharing thread
threadSharing.rule: Keep the chosen teammate and saved transcript visible; disable duplicate share requests until access is accepted.

threadShared.label: Thread shared
threadShared.rule: Show the named teammate’s accepted access beside the transcript; only now may the sharing invitation be sent.

threadShareFailed.label: Sharing failed
threadShareFailed.rule: Do not claim the teammate has access; retain the chosen teammate and allow a deliberate retry of the same share.

threadNew.label: New conversation
threadNew.rule: Show an empty saved conversation with a blank prompt; no agent response or tool result exists before the first question is sent.

threadSendFailed.label: Question not sent
threadSendFailed.rule: Keep the unsent prompt editable and separate from accepted history; retry the same send without creating a duplicate prompt.

threadStopFailed.label: Stop failed
threadStopFailed.rule: Cancellation was not acknowledged; retain partial output, do not claim the response is stopped, and offer another stop request while checking the running operation.

agentsCreated.label: New agent listed
agentsCreated.rule: Show the accepted launch researcher in the agent list as idle with no completed runs; creation does not grant a read scope.

threadSendEvent.label: Send a question to the agent

threadShareEvent.label: Share this saved thread with a teammate

threadOpenShareEvent.label: Choose a teammate to share with

flows.goal: Send a question and inspect the agent answer after approving only the requested read scope.
flows.ends: The saved thread contains the accepted prompt, approved query and scope, tool result and completed answer; denial or failure never produces a success result.

flows.goal: Choose an existing agent suited to a team question.
flows.ends: The chosen agent is named in the conversation before the first question; no read permission is implied by choosing it.

flows.goal: Give a teammate access to the same saved agent reasoning.
flows.ends: The selected teammate has accepted access to the saved transcript and receives an invitation only after sharing succeeds.

flows.goal: Choose which conversation events notify me while keeping new chats private.
flows.ends: Saved notification, speed and chat-privacy choices survive reopening Settings; tool reads remain approval-gated.

flows.goal: Understand exactly what approving a read or sharing a conversation permits.
flows.ends: The teammate can distinguish a one-time read grant, a saved scope grant and access to a shared transcript.

flows.goal: Create a named agent with a response speed and team visibility.
flows.ends: The accepted agent appears in Agents with its name and configuration; creating it does not authorize a tool read.

binding.because: Naming an agent and choosing its answering behavior requires an explicit creation outcome separate from running it.

flows.goal: Learn whether inspectable agent answers suit the team’s work.
flows.ends: The product action opens saved Chats; read-scope help explains approval without initiating a tool call.

flows.goal: Open the saved conversation a teammate shared with me.
flows.ends: The invitation opens the accepted shared transcript with the same calls and results visible to the sender.

flows.goal: Return to the exact tool read that cannot run without my decision.
flows.ends: The push opens the pending query and scope; the tool remains unexecuted until the teammate allows it.

surfaces.question: Which conversation should I resume or start?

binding.because: Existing team and agent threads hold the work to resume.

surfaces.question: What did the agent do, and what should the team ask next?

binding.because: Long agent explanations and exact tool calls read better as full-width turns.

slots.because: The teammate must inspect the exact requested query and read scope before permitting this tool call.
Sharing confirmation stays beside the saved thread and names the teammate who now has access.

surfaces.question: Which agent can handle this task, and does it need access?
What should this agent be called, how carefully should it answer, and can the team use it?
When should Plover notify me, and who can read a new conversation?

binding.because: Notification choices and private-by-default chats can be saved together, while tool-read approval remains mandatory.

surfaces.question: What exactly does a tool approval permit, and who can see its result?
Can my team inspect the same agent answer and approve only the data it needs?
Which conversation can I now read, and where are its agent calls and results?
Which pending read is waiting for my decision before the agent can continue?
